name: Equinix SY10x (xScale)

address.note: SSD-53338465 assessment report: expansion (second building, SY10) on the western portion of the existing SY9 data centre site at 8 Grand Avenue, legally Lot 10 DP 1275083. master.csv '10 Grand Avenue' was the address used in the 2019 DA/751/2019 panel listing for the whole campus.

lat.note: geocoded: NSW address point for 8 Grand Avenue Rosehill (the western part of the shared SY9/SY10 site, where SY10 is proposed)

builder.note: not found (A W Edwards built SY9x; no SY10x contractor identified)

developer.value: Equinix Hyperscale 2 (SY10) Pty Limited (SSD applicant); Equinix / PGIM Real Estate xScale JV

mw_it.note: EIS: '31.2MW (IT Load) data centre facility'; assessment report: 'operational capacity of 31.2 MW'. Equinix Jun 2022 release said 'more than 28 MW' power capacity (source 1).

cost_aud_m.note: Capital investment value $293,360,197 (SSD-53338465 assessment report). JV US$575m (reported A$775m) covers SY9x and SY10x.

authority.note: Stage 2 was also covered in concept form by DA/751/2019 (Sydney Central City Planning Panel, 31 Jul 2020)

pathway.note: Detailed consent for the Stage 2 building contemplated by the DA/751/2019 concept approval; DA/751/2019/D (8 Jun 2023) revised SY10 built form

lodged.note: Lodgement date not stated; scoping report Jan 2023; EIS exhibited 27 Oct - 23 Nov 2023 (source 5)

jobs_construction.note: Assessment report: 'expected to generate up to 250 construction jobs' / '250 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS: 'up to 250 full-time equivalent (FTE) construction jobs' and 'direct employment, including 250 construction jobs'. No peak/average definition given.

jobs_operational.note: '36 operational jobs'; EIS: '36 operational FTE employees'

jobs_operational_other.note: whole SY9+SY10 campus: 'the equivalent of 36 operational full time equivalent jobs, with the existing SY9 facility seeing the equivalent of 50, resulting in 86 for the entire facility'

construction_start.note: EIS (2023) programme: main works 15 months from Aug 2024, completion Jan 2026 (pre-approval plan, superseded by Dec 2024 consent). No commencement evidence found; the portal shows no post-approval documents as at 2026-09-27.

open_questions: status: under_construction per trackers (Baxtel 'Under Construction', planned 2027) not verified; no construction start, builder or post-approval documents found
